label: keys

events.location: on the white desk, beside the wallet and the lanyard

notes:
DRAFT -- drafted by Claude from frame-by-frame inspection, NOT yet confirmed in the annotator. The tracked object is the keyring with the red/purple round tag and the pale leather strap. A SECOND keyring (black fob) and a rainbow lanyard with its own keys are on the desk throughout, which is why distractor_ids is not empty -- this is the only clip in the corpus where 'is this MY keyring' is testable.
Carried in hand from t=1.5 while the wearer walks the flat, set on the white desk at t=11.5, out of shot t=14.5-34.5 (kitchen, hall console, bedroom), then the desk is in shot again from t=34.5 to the end at t=46.7 with the keyring untouched.
The tail is the valuable part: hands are busy on that desk at t=40.5-43.5 but never on this keyring, so the windows ending at t=35/42/46.7 are the corpus's first windows where the object is present and nothing happens to it -- the false-placement gate is measured only there.
Boxes are sparse and deliberately unevenly spread: 45-80 (tracked, hand), 120/140 (on the desk), 420/465 (the tail). Frames 85-115 and 345-415 have none, so no IoU is scored there -- notably the window ending at t=35 can be scored for its event but not for grounding. On the desk the keyring is 43-71 px on target, below the ~128 px identity floor.
